integrity: Two independent exhaustive exact-integer algorithms enumerate all 3^16 labeled configurations for each graph; explicit graph and spectrum checks; same-model review only; historical priority beyond inspected records is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Finite 16-site models only; the two graphs, three colors, uniform positive bond penalty and one-color uniform field are fixed. No thermodynamic-limit claim and no universal spectral classification.
title: Magnetic fingerprints of two cospectral sixteen-site Potts antiferromagnets
